items.name: Hrafnsholm Raven Cloak
items.lore: The Wardens' raven, the right way up. Given to those who took Hrafnsholm back.

items.name: Rune-Chain Ring
items.lore: A link of the jotun's chain, the runes ground off.

items.name: Watch-Hold Torc
items.lore: Bog-iron, the hold's tower on it.

items.name: Barrow-Breaker Bracer
items.lore: Rowan and iron, against the dead.

items.name: Hrafnkel's Barrow-Gold
items.lore: Three-hundred-year-old gold, cold to the touch.

items.name: Bergelmir's Broken Chain
items.lore: The jotun's chain, broken. He'd want you to have it.

draughts: Hallveig's own. Brown, and better than it looks.
Clean and bitter. The dead hate it.
The Wardens' mead. Everything comes back a little faster after a cup.
